result.instructions: Tools for CharityFundraiser, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which donations came in this week, and what is the total?"; "Find the contact record for jane@example.com and add the tag 'major donor'."; "List our upcoming events.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CharityFundraiser data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run charityfundraiser_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run charityfundraiser_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run charityfundraiser_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. charityfundraiser_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: charityfundraiser_get_account
tools.title: Check the API key and organization
tools.description: Confirm that the API key works and show which CharityFundraiser organization it belongs to. Good first call. API: GET /api/v1/me.

annotations.title: Check the API key and organization

tools.name: charityfundraiser_list_donations
tools.title: List donations
tools.description: List donations for the organization, newest first. Use since (an ISO 8601 timestamp) for an incremental sync that pulls only new donations. Returns id, amount, currency, donor name and email, payment_status, created_at and paid_at. API: GET /api/v1/donations.

since.description: Only donations created at or after this ISO 8601 date or timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: charityfundraiser_list_transactions
tools.title: List payment transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions for the organization: donations, event tickets, point-of-sale sales and other payments. API: GET /api/v1/transactions.

tools.name: charityfundraiser_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts and donors. Filter by a search string (name or email) or by donor tier (for example Major, Mid, Grassroots, Lapsed or Prospect). API: GET /api/v1/contacts.

search.description: Text to match against contact name or email.

tier.description: Donor tier to filter by, for example Major, Mid, Grassroots, Lapsed or Prospect.

tools.name: charityfundraiser_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the organization's events (auctions, galas, golf tournaments and other fundraisers). API: GET /api/v1/events.

tools.name: charityfundraiser_upsert_contact
tools.title: Create or update a contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update the existing contact with the same email (upsert by email). Tags are merged with existing tags. Calling it again with the same data changes nothing. API: POST /api/v1/contacts.

email.description: Contact email. It identifies the contact for the upsert.

tags.description: Tags. On create or update, tags are merged with the existing tags.

tools.name: charityfundraiser_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change the name, phone or tags of one contact by its id (from charityfundraiser_list_contacts). Give at least one field. Tags are merged with existing tags. API: PATCH /api/v1/contacts/{id}.

tags.description: Tags. On create or update, tags are merged with the existing tags.
